moments.title: The Hundred finals weekend approaching
moments.blurb: The Hundred cricket tournament continues this weekend with matches across the UK, leading up to Finals Day at Lord's on Sunday, August 16th.

source.l: The Hundred Official Website / Radio Times

angles.name: Weekend Matches
angles.copy: Catch The Hundred action this weekend! Today sees MI London vs Trent Rockets and Southern Brave vs Manchester Super Giants. Tomorrow, Sunrisers Leeds face Welsh Fire and London Spirit take on Birmingham Phoenix. Who are you backing?

angles.name: Finals Countdown
angles.copy: Only 8 days until The Hundred Finals Day at Lord's! The tension is building as teams battle for a spot in the ultimate showdown on August 16th.

angles.name: Welsh Fire Focus
angles.copy: Our very own Welsh Fire are in action tomorrow against Sunrisers Leeds! Get behind the team and cheer them on. #GoWelshFire

moments.title: European Athletics Championships begin Monday
moments.blurb: The European Athletics Championships kick off in Birmingham on Monday, August 10th, running until August 16th, marking the first time the UK has hosted the standalone event.

angles.name: Championships Start
angles.copy: Ready, set, go! The European Athletics Championships begin Monday in Birmingham. Get ready for a week of top-tier track and field action!

angles.name: Home Soil Advantage
angles.copy: History in the making! The UK hosts the standalone European Athletics Championships for the first time ever, starting Monday in Birmingham. Who are you hoping to see on the podium?

moments.title: Premier League 2026/27 season kick-off
moments.blurb: The Premier League 2026/27 season is set to kick off on August 21st or 22nd, with fixtures already announced.

angles.name: New Season Excitement
angles.copy: Just two weeks to go! The Premier League returns on August 21st/22nd. Who's ready for another season of drama?

angles.name: Latest Start Ever
angles.copy: The 2026/27 Premier League season marks the latest start date in its history, kicking off August 21st/22nd. Let the debates begin!

moments.title: Reading & Leeds Festival countdown
moments.blurb: Reading & Leeds Festival is just weeks away, taking place from August 27th to 30th across Reading's Richfield Avenue and Leeds' Bramham Park.

angles.name: Festival Vibes Looming
angles.copy: Who's got their wellies ready? Reading & Leeds Festival is just around the corner, August 27-30! What acts are you most excited for?

angles.name: Lineup Anticipation
angles.copy: Reading & Leeds is set to deliver another diverse lineup balancing pop, rock, rap and more. The bank holiday weekend of August 27-30 can't come soon enough!

moments.title: Sam Fender & Olivia Dean hold UK #1
moments.blurb: Sam Fender and Olivia Dean's 'Rein Me In' remains at Number 1 on the Official UK Singles Chart for the week ending August 15, 2026.

angles.name: Chart Toppers
angles.copy: Still reigning! Sam Fender & Olivia Dean's 'Rein Me In' holds strong at UK Number 1. What a track!

angles.name: New Chart Entries
angles.copy: Fresh blood on the charts! Ariana Grande has two new entries with 'petal' and 'kiss me'. Hear them on Nation Hits!
